title: The free online course that got me a 6 figure job

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know a free online course landed me a six-figure job in tech?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With AI and automation taking over, upskilling isn’t optional — it’s urgent.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a 12-week bootcamp called "Data Science for Everyone" on Coursera.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The course includes hands-on projects with real-world data from IBM.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It helped me land a role at a top startup — no degree required.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key? Applying what you learn to solve real problems, fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one skill you could learn today that pays off big?
